projects.title: Capybara

projects.status: Active source project; v0.2.2 was released 2026-08-31 and the repository was updated 2026-09-10. It requires a flash dump from the user's own device and distributes no firmware or keys.

projects.strategy: ARMv7-M and measured Sonix SNC73410 peripheral emulation for factory firmware

projects.title: rax
projects.game: Linux guest software, bare-metal programs, and bytecode for supported CPU architectures
projects.platform: x86-64, Arm/AArch64, Qualcomm Hexagon, RISC-V RV64, eBPF, and Solana SBPF guest architectures
projects.status: Active research project; v0.1.2 was released 2026-09-16 and the repository continued to receive changes on 2026-10-15. The README documents Linux boot paths for x86-64/AArch64, bare-metal Hexagon and RISC-V paths, and user-mode Linux ELF execution. The maintainer says it is not a production hypervisor or security sandbox.
projects.summary: Rust CPU and system emulator covering multiple processor and bytecode architectures. The documented current paths include x86-64 and AArch64 Linux guests, bare-metal Hexagon/RISC-V programs, and user-mode Linux executables; the project describes itself as research software.
projects.strategy: Multi-architecture software CPU emulation, user-mode execution, and virtual-machine system models
